events.title: PITCHFORK is in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello Peasants! PITCHFORK is in Steam Next Fest!To celebrate, update #3 is now live!In this update we: Updated the dithering shader to improve how the game looks on livestreams and recordings.Added anti vampire propaganda to the village. Fixed some spots peasants could become stuck within the village. Tweaked spike trap spawn rates.As always - please let us know if you run into any issues or have any ideas about what you'd like to see in the full game! Join our peasant congregation here: https:/

events.title: PITCHFORK Demo Update #2
events.summary: Hello Peasants! We're back again with another small update to improve your dungeon crawling endeavors. In this update we: Filled various small holes spotted in the caves. Added portal culling within the dungeon to reduce frame times on lower end hardware.Improved the usability of the settings menu.Tweaked the visuals of frost and shock effects so that their effects are clearer.Reduced the intensity of the feedback played when dealing damage.Made the fog in the village less distracting. events.title: PITCHFORK Demo is out NOW!
events.summary: Hello Peasants! The Demo for PITCHFORK has JUST GONE LIVE! Gather your friends, and begin the climb up the Vampire's castle today!The Demo includes: Around an hour of playtime.Solo, or co-op play with up to 4 players. Proximity voice chat.The first procedural floor of the castle (the Sewers). Over 40 items.3 monsters.Many traps & puzzles.The full game includes: More floors. More items. More traps. More puzzles. More enemies. Character CustomizationAnd of course - the Vampire boss fight!PITCHFORK
